pages.text: Blow the horn ($(thing)right-click$()) to give an order to all your companions within 32 blocks:$(li)$(thing)aiming at a creature$(): they all attack it, even if peaceful;$(li)$(thing)aiming at nothing$(): they stop fighting and regroup.$(br2)Companions in $(thing)Stay$() hold their position. Players, companions and your own pets can't be targeted.
Four copper ingots and a gold coin.
